title: The F.B.I.’s Extraordinary Seizure of Voting Records

sentences.zh: 我凌晨4点半给总统打了电话，他接听了。

sentences.zh: 七十年的太空探索。

sentences.en: We want to see what's beyond the next star.
sentences.zh: 我们想看看下一颗恒星之外有什么。

sentences.zh: 60份超级圣代。

sentences.en: The New York Times, celebrating 175 years of helping you understand the world and make the most of each day.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》，庆祝175年来致力于帮助您了解世界并充分利用每一天。

sentences.en: Subscribe now for a special offer at nytimes.com slash subscribe.
sentences.zh: 现在订阅可享受特别优惠，网址：nytimes.com/subscribe。

sentences.en: From The New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报》的迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这是《每日简报》。

sentences.en: Today.
sentences.zh: 今日要闻。

sentences.en: What we're learning about the FBI's highly unusual seizure of voting records last week in Georgia.
sentences.zh: 我们来了解一下联邦调查局上周在佐治亚州极其罕见地查封选票记录一事。

sentences.en: The presence of the nation's top intelligence official at the scene.
sentences.zh: 国家最高情报官员出现在现场。

sentences.en: And the stunning phone call that reveals how personally involved President Trump has become in the investigation.
sentences.zh: 以及那通令人震惊的电话，揭示了特朗普总统对这项调查的个人介入程度有多深。

sentences.en: I spoke with my colleague, Devlin Barrett.
sentences.zh: 我采访了我的同事德夫林·巴雷特。

sentences.en: It's Tuesday, February 3rd.
sentences.zh: 今天是2月3日，星期二。

sentences.en: Devlin, this story begins with a dramatic scene which unfolded a few days ago in Fulton County, Georgia.
sentences.zh: 德夫林，这个故事始于几天前在佐治亚州富尔顿县发生的一幕戏剧性场景。

sentences.en: Can you just describe that to us?
sentences.zh: 你能为我们描述一下吗？

sentences.en: Sure.
sentences.zh: 当然可以。

sentences.en: So take a live look at the Fulton County Elections Office near Atlanta.
sentences.zh: 让我们看看亚特兰大附近富尔顿县选举办公室的现场画面。

sentences.en: Last Wednesday morning, a group of FBI agents show up for a massive undertaking.
sentences.zh: 上周三上午，一群联邦调查局特工出现，执行一项大规模任务。

sentences.en: The collection of a huge volume of stuff related to the 2020 election in Fulton County.
sentences.zh: 收集与富尔顿县2020年选举相关的大量资料。

sentences.en: FBI agents spent the afternoon inside the records warehouse for the Fulton County, Georgia Board of Elections.
sentences.zh: 联邦调查局特工在佐治亚州富尔顿县选举委员会的记录仓库里待了一下午。

sentences.en: Fulton County contains the city of Atlanta, so obviously it has a lot of election records.
sentences.zh: 富尔顿县包含亚特兰大市，所以显然有很多选举记录。

sentences.en: But specifically, what the agents were there to get were the paper ballots from that election, but also other things such as voter rolls, such as tabulation tapes,
sentences.zh: 但具体来说，特工们去那里是为了获取那次选举的纸质选票，以及其他物品，比如选民名单、计票磁带，

sentences.en: all of which is essentially data and documentation about the 2020 election.
sentences.zh: 所有这些本质上都是关于2020年选举的数据和文件。

sentences.en: So just to be clear, every single ballot or close to it from an election six years ago is taken by the FBI out of this building.
sentences.zh: 所以明确一下，六年前那场选举的每一张选票，或者说几乎每一张，都被联邦调查局从这栋大楼里带走了。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And it takes hours to load all those hundreds of boxes into trucks and bring them to an FBI storage facility.
sentences.zh: 他们花了几个小时把那几百个箱子装上卡车，运往联邦调查局的存储设施。

sentences.en: And what exactly is the rationale for this search?
sentences.zh: 那么这次搜查的理由究竟是什么？

sentences.en: I think by now, most people understand President Trump has a fixation on Fulton County.
sentences.zh: 我想现在大多数人都明白，特朗普总统对富尔顿县有一种执念。

sentences.en: And it's recurring place in his baseless claims of election fraud in 2020 when he lost re-election.
sentences.zh: 在他2020年竞选连任失败后，富尔顿县反复出现在他毫无根据的选举舞弊指控中。

sentences.en: But those claims of fraud, we've covered them many times on this show in Fulton County, they have been so thoroughly litigated and re-litigated that it would be hard to understand
sentences.zh: 但这些舞弊指控，我们在节目中报道过很多次，在富尔顿县，它们已经被彻底地诉讼和再诉讼过，很难理解

sentences.en: why a new investigation into them would ever be undertaken.
sentences.zh: 为什么还要对它们进行新的调查。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: This stuff has been investigated before.
sentences.zh: 这些东西以前就被调查过了。

sentences.en: These ballots have been counted multiple times to make sure they got the count right.
sentences.zh: 这些选票已经被清点过多次，以确保计票无误。

sentences.en: And it's always checked out.
sentences.zh: 而且每次都核实无误。

sentences.en: And so when you see an investigation like this, when you see an FBI search warrant like this, it raises the obvious question, well, why now?
sentences.zh: 所以当你看到这样的调查，看到这样的联邦调查局搜查令时，就会产生一个显而易见的问题：为什么是现在？

sentences.en: What has changed?
sentences.zh: 发生了什么变化？

sentences.en: What new or different information do we have to justify this search?
sentences.zh: 我们有什么新的或不同的信息来证明这次搜查的合理性？

sentences.en: And the reality is the affidavit that is the underlying rationale for the search warrant, we can't see that still sealed.
sentences.zh: 事实是，作为搜查令基础理由的宣誓书，我们还无法看到，它仍然处于密封状态。

sentences.en: So we don't know exactly what evidentiary argument was made to justify this.
sentences.zh: 所以我们不知道究竟是什么证据论点被提出来证明这一点。

sentences.en: But we know what the theoretical argument is, right?
sentences.zh: 但我们知道理论上的论点是什么，对吧？

sentences.en: It's just not possible to have lost Georgia.
sentences.zh: 输掉佐治亚州是不可能的。

sentences.en: It's not possible.
sentences.zh: 这不可能。

sentences.en: Trump's been making it more or less for six years.
sentences.zh: 特朗普六年来一直在说这个。

sentences.en: In Georgia, the secretary of state began illegally processing ballots weeks before election day.
sentences.zh: 在佐治亚州，州务卿在选举日前几周就开始非法处理选票了。

sentences.en: That somehow, some way.
sentences.zh: 以某种方式，某种手段。

sentences.en: Thousands and thousands of counterfeit ballots for Joe Biden.
sentences.zh: 为乔·拜登准备了成千上万张伪造选票。

sentences.en: These ballots, this evidence shows election fraud.
sentences.zh: 这些选票，这些证据显示了选举舞弊。

sentences.en: Now, very recently, you've seen the president come back to this subject.
sentences.zh: 现在，就在最近，你看到总统又回到了这个话题上。

sentences.en: It's great to be back in beautiful Davos, Switzerland.
sentences.zh: 很高兴回到美丽的瑞士达沃斯。

sentences.en: For example, when the president speaks at Davos, Switzerland last month.
sentences.zh: 例如，上个月总统在瑞士达沃斯发表讲话时。

sentences.en: It was a rigged election.
sentences.zh: 那是一场被操纵的选举。

sentences.en: Everybody now knows that.
sentences.zh: 现在每个人都知道了。

sentences.en: They found out.
sentences.zh: 他们发现了。

sentences.en: He talks about the 2020 election.
sentences.zh: 他谈到了2020年的选举。

sentences.en: People will soon be prosecuted for what they did.
sentences.zh: 人们很快就会因为他们的所作所为而被起诉。

sentences.en: It's probably breaking news, but it should be.
sentences.zh: 这可能是突发新闻，但本该如此。

sentences.en: And he predicts that there will be prosecutions of people.
sentences.zh: 他预言会有人被起诉。

sentences.en: But Devin, how does the president start to make the threats that he issued in a place like Davos turn into reality?
sentences.zh: 但是德夫林，总统是如何让他在达沃斯那样的地方发出的威胁变成现实的呢？

sentences.en: And how does he get to this FBI search of this voting facility in Fulton County, given the highly public lack of evidence that any fraud ever occurred?
sentences.zh: 鉴于没有任何舞弊发生的证据是众所周知的，他是如何促成联邦调查局对富尔顿县这个投票设施进行搜查的？

sentences.en: So the administration assigns this case to a federal prosecutor in Missouri.
sentences.zh: 政府将此案指派给了密苏里州的一名联邦检察官。

sentences.en: Missouri, not Georgia.
sentences.zh: 是密苏里州，而不是佐治亚州。

sentences.en: That seems notable.
sentences.zh: 这看起来很值得注意。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: This investigative effort, this search in Georgia, is not being overseen by a prosecutor in Atlanta,
sentences.zh: 这次调查行动，这次在佐治亚州的搜查，并不是由亚特兰大的检察官监督的，

sentences.en: which I think is noteworthy because the federal prosecutor's office in Atlanta had already looked at this years earlier and decided there was nothing to pursue.
sentences.zh: 我认为这很值得注意，因为亚特兰大的联邦检察官办公室几年前就已经调查过此事，并认定没有什么可追究的。

sentences.en: And in addition to the federal prosecutor in Missouri, the other key person driving this forward is Tulsi Gabbard, the director of national intelligence.
sentences.zh: 除了密苏里州的联邦检察官，推动此事的另一个关键人物是国家情报总监图尔西·加巴德。

sentences.en: She runs an agency that frankly is supposed to be looking at foreign security threats, cyber threats.
sentences.zh: 她管理着一个本应负责关注外国安全威胁和网络威胁的机构。

sentences.en: And very oddly, she goes to the scene of this search.
sentences.zh: 非常奇怪的是，她去了搜查现场。

sentences.en: She goes to the election hub building in Fulton County and is on scene as part of the search group.
sentences.zh: 她去了富尔顿县的选举中心大楼，并作为搜查小组的一员出现在现场。

sentences.en: And that is not the normal way of running an FBI search.
sentences.zh: 这并不是联邦调查局进行搜查的正常方式。

sentences.en: That is certainly not something that I've seen before with any DNI or, for that matter, with any senior FBI official.
sentences.zh: 这肯定不是我以前见过的任何国家情报总监，或者说任何高级联邦调查局官员会做的事。

sentences.en: You know, if you want to cast back to something like the FBI search at Mar-a-Lago, it's not like there were senior FBI officials running that search.
sentences.zh: 你知道，如果你回想一下联邦调查局对海湖庄园的搜查，并不是说有高级联邦调查局官员在现场指挥搜查。

sentences.en: That was done by bureau personnel.
sentences.zh: 那是局里的人员做的。

sentences.en: There were managers there, certainly, but they weren't having the heads of agencies run it.
sentences.zh: 现场当然有管理人员，但他们并没有让机构负责人来指挥。

sentences.en: So from what you're saying, the way the president gets this FBI search is he kind of cobbles together a group of willing participants
sentences.zh: 所以照你所说，总统促成这次联邦调查局搜查的方式，是他拼凑了一群愿意参与的人，

sentences.en: who will do this for him, one of whom is the director of national intelligence.
sentences.zh: 他们会为他做这件事，其中之一就是国家情报总监。

sentences.en: And as you're saying, that seems highly unusual that she would end up at the scene of this FBI search.
sentences.zh: 正如你所说，她最终出现在这次联邦调查局搜查的现场，这看起来非常不寻常。

sentences.en: What could explain that?
sentences.zh: 这能怎么解释呢？

sentences.en: What our reporting has found is that the president ordered her to go.
sentences.zh: 我们的报道发现，是总统命令她去的。

sentences.en: The president told her to go.
sentences.zh: 总统告诉她去。

sentences.en: And she is there on his direction, and she is acting on his behalf.
sentences.zh: 她是奉他的指示在那里，并代表他行事。

sentences.en: And I think it speaks to the degree to which the president is personally interested in this investigation.
sentences.zh: 我认为这说明了总统对这项调查的个人兴趣程度。

sentences.en: The president is personally pushing forward this investigation.
sentences.zh: 总统正在亲自推动这项调查。

sentences.en: And it speaks to, I think, the people within his administration that are willing to do this kind of thing for him.
sentences.zh: 而且我认为，这说明了他政府内部的人愿意为他做这种事。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Well, let's keep talking about Gabber for just a moment and why she would be willing to do this.
sentences.zh: 好吧，让我们继续谈谈加巴德，以及她为什么愿意这样做。

sentences.en: As you're saying, this doesn't exactly seem like the most natural use of her time, but Gabbert famously seems to want to please the president.
sentences.zh: 正如你所说，这看起来并不像是她最自然的时间利用方式，但加巴德以似乎想要取悦总统而闻名。

sentences.en: And we know that because many months ago, she publicly claimed without evidence that former President Barack Obama
sentences.zh: 我们知道这一点，因为几个月前，她曾公开声称，在没有证据的情况下，前总统巴拉克·奥巴马

sentences.en: had potentially criminally violated the law because his administration began the Trump-Russia investigation.
sentences.zh: 可能触犯了法律，因为他的政府启动了特朗普-俄罗斯调查。

sentences.en: She suggested that perhaps Obama should be charged with a crime.
sentences.zh: 她暗示奥巴马或许应该被控犯罪。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And I think you've seen throughout the administration instances where she has played up many of the unfounded accusations,
sentences.zh: 我认为在整个政府任期内，你已经看到她多次附和那些毫无根据的指控，

sentences.en: many of the suspicions that President Trump promotes himself.
sentences.zh: 附和特朗普总统本人宣扬的许多怀疑。

sentences.en: And so I think she has been a very eager participant in Trump's push to find purported evidence of voter fraud in 2020
sentences.zh: 所以我认为，她是特朗普推动寻找2020年选民舞弊所谓证据的积极参与者，

sentences.en: and Trump's push to try to build a criminal case against people he doesn't like over the fact that he lost the election in 2020.
sentences.zh: 也是特朗普试图针对他不喜欢的人建立刑事案件，以报复他输掉2020年选举这一事实的积极参与者。

sentences.en: Got it.
sentences.zh: 明白了。

sentences.en: So that's how we get the director of national intelligence basically going to this FBI raid as the president's eyes and ears.
sentences.zh: 所以这就是为什么国家情报总监基本上作为总统的耳目，去了这次联邦调查局的突击搜查现场。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 完全正确。

sentences.en: And what does Gabbert actually do at the scene when FBI agents are grabbing all of these ballots and voting technologies?
sentences.zh: 那么当联邦调查局特工在搜集所有这些选票和投票技术设备时，加巴德在现场到底做了什么？

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So there's not really much for a director of national intelligence to do at a search.
sentences.zh: 所以国家情报总监在搜查现场其实没什么事可做。

sentences.en: But what she is seen doing when she's there is talking to someone on the phone.
sentences.zh: 但当她在那里时，人们看到她在打电话。

sentences.en: She's walking around.
sentences.zh: 她走来走去。

sentences.en: She's visible.
sentences.zh: 她很显眼。

sentences.en: She's present.
sentences.zh: 她在场。

sentences.en: Kind of lurking.
sentences.zh: 有点像在潜伏。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And so that's significant and unusual.
sentences.zh: 所以这很重要，也很不寻常。

sentences.en: But what's far more unusual is what happens after the search.
sentences.zh: 但更不寻常的是搜查之后发生的事情。

sentences.en: When she has a meeting with some of the FBI agents who conducted the search and that meeting really reveals a lot about the president's interest in all this
sentences.zh: 当她与一些执行搜查的联邦调查局特工会面时，那次会面确实揭示了总统对这一切的兴趣，

sentences.en: and also may end up undercutting everything the president is trying to achieve.
sentences.zh: 而且最终可能会削弱总统试图实现的一切目标。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: I'm Wynna Liu.
sentences.zh: 我是温娜·刘。

sentences.en: I write the game Connections, one of the puzzles from New York Times Games.
sentences.zh: 我编写了《纽约时报》游戏中的拼图游戏《Connections》。

sentences.en: And I love horror movies.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢恐怖电影。

sentences.en: I love my dog.
sentences.zh: 我爱我的狗。

sentences.en: And I love trying to trick you.
sentences.zh: 我还喜欢尝试捉弄你。

sentences.en: I'm Sam Mazursky.
sentences.zh: 我是萨姆·马祖斯基。

sentences.en: And I create the game Spelling Bee and Letterboxd on a daily basis.
sentences.zh: 我每天负责创作《Spelling Bee》和《Letterboxd》游戏。

sentences.en: And I have this thing called promesthesia.
sentences.zh: 我有一种叫做联觉的东西。

sentences.en: I see color when I'm listening to music.
sentences.zh: 我在听音乐时能看到颜色。

sentences.en: New York Times games are made by people like the ones you just heard from.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》的游戏是由像你们刚才听到的人那样的人制作的。

sentences.en: Go to nytimes.com slash games to start playing today.
sentences.zh: 访问 nytimes.com/games 立即开始游戏。

sentences.en: So, Delvin, tell us about this meeting that Tulsi Gabbard, the director of national intelligence, has after the FBI search.
sentences.zh: 那么，德夫林，告诉我们关于国家情报总监图尔西·加巴德在联邦调查局搜查后举行的那次会议。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So after the search, Tulsi Gabbard goes to the FBI field office to talk to some of the agents who worked the search.
sentences.zh: 搜查结束后，图尔西·加巴德去了联邦调查局外勤办公室，与一些参与搜查的特工交谈。

sentences.en: And it's not completely unheard of for a senior official to visit the FBI field office.
sentences.zh: 高级官员访问联邦调查局外勤办公室并非闻所未闻。

sentences.en: The agents sometimes get VIP visits.
sentences.zh: 特工们有时会接待贵宾访问。

sentences.en: But what happens in the meeting quickly becomes quite strange and quite concerning to some people.
sentences.zh: 但会议中发生的事情很快变得非常奇怪，也让一些人感到非常担忧。

sentences.en: What happens is while she's talking to the agents, she decides to call President Trump.
sentences.zh: 发生的事情是，当她与特工交谈时，她决定给特朗普总统打电话。

sentences.en: And the first time she calls, she doesn't get through.
sentences.zh: 第一次拨打时，她没打通。

sentences.en: But very quickly after that, Trump calls her back.
sentences.zh: 但很快，特朗普就回电给她了。

sentences.en: And Tulsi Gabbard puts President Trump on speakerphone to talk to the other agents.
sentences.zh: 图尔西·加巴德把特朗普总统的电话调成免提，让他与特工们通话。

sentences.en: And what's described to us is that at first the president is essentially just thanking them and praising them for their work.
sentences.zh: 据描述，起初总统基本上只是在感谢和赞扬他们的工作。

sentences.en: But then he starts to ask some questions.
sentences.zh: 但随后他开始提出一些问题。

sentences.en: And at that point, the supervisor in the room tries to essentially run point on answering those questions.
sentences.zh: 就在那时，房间里的主管试图主要负责回答这些问题。

sentences.en: Because now you're getting into a very dicey area where the president himself is asking questions of the field agents, the people on the ground doing the work.
sentences.zh: 因为现在你进入了一个非常棘手的领域，总统本人正在向外勤特工，即在现场执行工作的人员提问。

sentences.en: And, you know, the whole thing is incredibly legally fraught and complicated.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，整件事在法律上极其棘手且复杂。

sentences.en: Well, just explain why it's legally fraught.
sentences.zh: 那么，请解释一下为什么这在法律上存在问题。

sentences.en: I can imagine practically why it's fraught because suddenly you have a bunch of FBI agents talking with the president of the United States about a live investigation.
sentences.zh: 我能从实际层面想象为什么会有问题，因为突然间，一群联邦调查局特工在与美国总统讨论一项正在进行的调查。

sentences.en: But legally, what's the issue?
sentences.zh: 但从法律角度看，问题出在哪里？

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: I mean, on a basic level, it's a bad look, right?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，从基本层面来看，这看起来很糟糕，对吧？

sentences.en: You have the person who has demanded this investigation, the politically powerful person who's demanded this investigation,
sentences.zh: 你让那个要求进行这项调查的人，那个拥有政治权力的要求进行这项调查的人，

sentences.en: now talking to the people who are supposedly doing an independent and very fact-based investigation.
sentences.zh: 现在却在与那些理应进行独立且基于事实调查的人交谈。

sentences.en: But it's legally problematic for a different but related reason.
sentences.zh: 但这在法律上存在问题，原因不同但相关。

sentences.en: And that is one of the things we've seen already in this administration is prosecutions that Trump wanted to see happen have fallen apart in part because he has so publicly and aggressively demanded certain people be prosecuted.
sentences.zh: 这就是我们在这届政府中已经看到的情况之一：特朗普希望看到的起诉最终破裂，部分原因是他如此公开且咄咄逼人地要求起诉某些人。

sentences.en: You see that in the cases against the former FBI director, James Comey.
sentences.zh: 你在针对前联邦调查局局长詹姆斯·科米的案件中看到了这一点。

sentences.en: You see that in the case against the New York attorney general, Letitia James.
sentences.zh: 你在针对纽约州总检察长莱蒂西亚·詹姆斯的案件中也看到了这一点。

sentences.en: There you saw arguments being made about vindictive prosecution.
sentences.zh: 在那里，你看到了关于“报复性起诉”的辩论。

sentences.en: And what the administration has argued to sort of counter claims of vindictive prosecution is, well,
sentences.zh: 而政府为了反驳“报复性起诉”的指控所提出的论点是，嗯，

sentences.en: it doesn't matter what the president says because it's the investigators and the prosecutors who are pursuing the case.
sentences.zh: 总统说什么并不重要，因为是调查人员和检察官在推进案件。

sentences.en: Well, if you have the president talking directly to the investigators,
sentences.zh: 好吧，如果你让总统直接与调查人员交谈，

sentences.en: it suddenly becomes much harder to argue that there isn't a connection between what the president wants and what the investigators are doing.
sentences.zh: 那么要辩称总统的意愿与调查人员的行为之间没有联系，就突然变得困难多了。

sentences.en: So you're sort of creating connective tissue for anyone who's ever charged in this, if anyone ever is, to argue, look, this is unjuSt.
sentences.zh: 所以，你实际上是在为任何被指控的人（如果有人被指控的话）制造关联，让他们可以辩称：看，这是不公正的。

sentences.en: This is unfair.
sentences.zh: 这是不公平的。

sentences.en: This case should be thrown out because the president is talking to the investigators in real time while they're still investigating.
sentences.zh: 这个案件应该被驳回，因为总统在他们还在调查时就实时与调查人员交谈。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: You're saying at some point when, in theory, somebody who ran the Fulton County election counting in 2020 is charged with a crime based on this search,
sentences.zh: 你是说在某种程度上，当理论上，某个在2020年负责富尔顿县计票工作的人因这次搜查而被指控犯罪时，

sentences.en: you can imagine at trial perhaps FBI agents being called to the stand to testify about Trump discussing the investigation with them.
sentences.zh: 你可以想象在审判中，联邦调查局特工可能会被传唤到证人席上，作证说特朗普曾与他们讨论过这项调查。

sentences.en: And it very much making clear how much Trump wanted these people to be charged, how personally invested he was in all this,
sentences.zh: 这非常清楚地表明了特朗普有多么希望这些人被起诉，他在这件事上投入了多少个人精力，

sentences.en: and that that would help make the case for vindictive prosecution and perhaps ultimately get whatever charges were brought tossed.
sentences.zh: 而这有助于支持“报复性起诉”的论点，并最终可能导致所提出的任何指控被撤销。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So there's a lot of reasons why legally, forget just politically or common sense-wise, legally this is not great if you ever want to try to build a criminal case out of this.
sentences.zh: 所以，从法律上讲，别说政治或常识层面，如果你想利用这一点来构建刑事案件，这在法律上是非常不利的，原因有很多。

sentences.en: So what we're seeing here is that this relentlessly hands-on approach from President Trump to this particular investigation, the 2020 election in Fulton County,
sentences.zh: 所以我们在这里看到的是，特朗普总统对这项特定调查——富尔顿县2020年选举——采取了这种不懈的亲力亲为的方式，

sentences.en: it's getting Trump what he wants on the front end.
sentences.zh: 这让特朗普在前期得到了他想要的。

sentences.en: I mean, those ballots were seized, but it's starting to undermine his ability to get what he wants on the back end, which is election officials in prison.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，那些选票被扣押了，但这开始削弱他在后期实现目标的能力，也就是让选举官员入狱。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And to be fair, this is in keeping with how he views himself in this second term.
sentences.zh: 公平地说，这与他在第二个任期内看待自己的方式是一致的。

sentences.en: He has said repeatedly, I am the chief law enforcement official in the United States.
sentences.zh: 他一再表示，我是美国最高执法官员。

sentences.en: I run the FBI and I run the Justice Department, not the attorney general, not the FBI, me, the president.
sentences.zh: 我管理联邦调查局，我管理司法部，不是总检察长，不是联邦调查局，是我，总统。

sentences.en: So what you see is him acting on that belief.
sentences.zh: 所以你看到的是他根据这种信念行事。

sentences.en: But I think that's a big difference from the courts accepting that this is appropriate behavior or this is the kind of behavior that will survive challenges in court.
sentences.zh: 但我认为，法院是否接受这是一种适当的行为，或者这是否是一种能够经受住法庭挑战的行为，有很大的区别。

sentences.en: Devlin, how are the election officials in Fulton County who have just been subjected to this raid, to this search, how are they responding to what has happened?
sentences.zh: 德夫林，富尔顿县那些刚刚遭受这次突袭、这次搜查的选举官员，他们对所发生的事情有何反应？

sentences.en: So.
sentences.zh: 那么。

sentences.en: We will not give one inch to those who seek to take control of elections in Fulton County.
sentences.zh: 对于那些试图控制富尔顿县选举的人，我们绝不会退让一寸。

sentences.en: They have already vowed to take the government to court to fight this, to essentially demand the evidence back.
sentences.zh: 他们已经发誓要将政府告上法庭来对抗这一行为，本质上是要求归还证据。

sentences.en: Are they opening the boxes?
sentences.zh: 他们在打开箱子吗？

sentences.en: Are they stuffing other ballots in there?
sentences.zh: 他们在往里面塞其他选票吗？

sentences.en: I have no clue.
sentences.zh: 我一点头绪都没有。

sentences.en: They say they're not comfortable with the Trump administration having control of these ballots.
sentences.zh: 他们说，他们对特朗普政府控制这些选票感到不安。

sentences.en: He does not want the midterm elections to take away his power.
sentences.zh: 他不想让中期选举夺走他的权力。

sentences.en: So he's trying to create chaos.
sentences.zh: 所以他试图制造混乱。

sentences.en: A few local election officials have gone further saying that the FBI search should scare everyone because this, to them, is really about the next election in 2026, the midterMs.
sentences.zh: 一些地方选举官员走得更远，称联邦调查局的搜查应该让每个人都感到害怕，因为对他们来说，这实际上是关于2026年的下一次选举，即中期选举。

sentences.en: Protect your vote at all costs.
sentences.zh: 不惜一切代价保护你的选票。

sentences.en: I'm telling you, everybody always says your life depends on it.
sentences.zh: 我告诉你，每个人总是说你的生命取决于它。

sentences.en: Oh, your life does depend on it this time.
sentences.zh: 哦，这次你的生命确实取决于它。

sentences.en: And what do they mean there?
sentences.zh: 他们那话是什么意思？

sentences.en: Look,
sentences.zh: 看，

sentences.en: I think the concern for a lot of election experts and a lot of Democrats is that the administration may at some point in the future try to use these claims of fraud to buttress their argument that some votes should not be counted or some results are not the right results.
sentences.zh: 我认为许多选举专家和许多民主党人担心的是，政府在未来的某个时候可能会试图利用这些欺诈指控来支持他们的论点，即某些选票不应被计入，或者某些结果不是正确的结果。

sentences.en: And those concerns are based on more than just this search in Fulton County.
sentences.zh: 而这些担忧不仅仅基于富尔顿县的这次搜查。

sentences.en: Over the last year, Trump's Justice Department has filed lawsuits seeking voter roll data, personal information about voters in almost half the states in the country.
sentences.zh: 在过去的一年里，特朗普的司法部提起了诉讼，寻求获取全国近一半州的选民名册数据和选民个人信息。

sentences.en: And that is something that hasn't been done before.
sentences.zh: 这是以前从未做过的事情。

sentences.en: That is very different and out of keeping with how voting has been managed up till now.
sentences.zh: 这非常不同，且与迄今为止选举管理的方式不符。

sentences.en: And I think a lot of the states who are fighting the Trump administration over these types of things see a larger pattern of trying to sow doubt about the integrity of elections,
sentences.zh: 我认为许多正在就这类事情与特朗普政府抗争的州，看到了一个更大的模式，即试图播下对选举公正性的怀疑，

sentences.en: trying to prepare the groundwork for maybe challenging results in 2026 if it doesn't go Trump's way.
sentences.zh: 试图为2026年的结果如果不如特朗普的意而进行挑战做铺垫。

sentences.en: That's an election in which, you know, there's certainly a possibility that the House of Representatives could become democratically controlled,
sentences.zh: 那是一场选举，你知道，众议院确实有可能被民主党控制，

sentences.en: and that would significantly curtail Trump's power as president over the following two years.
sentences.zh: 那将显著削弱特朗普在接下来的两年里作为总统的权力。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And as we know, doubts about election are just, at this point, central to the Trump movement.
sentences.zh: 而且我们知道，对选举的怀疑在这一点上是特朗普运动的核心。

sentences.en: And those doubts require stoking.
sentences.zh: 而这些怀疑需要煽动。

sentences.en: And this FBI search of this Fulton County election hub is an act of stoking.
sentences.zh: 而这次联邦调查局对富尔顿县选举中心的搜查就是一种煽动行为。

sentences.en: It puts the issue of election doubt, election denialism back on the radar for Americans at a time when most people aren't really thinking about it.
sentences.zh: 它在大多数人并没有真正考虑的时候，将选举怀疑论、选举否认主义的问题重新带回了美国人的视野中。

sentences.en: Think for a minute about what an FBI investigation is.
sentences.zh: 花一分钟想想什么是联邦调查局的调查。

sentences.en: By its very nature, an FBI investigation sows doubt and sows suspicion about the people being investigated.
sentences.zh: 就其本质而言，联邦调查局的调查会播下对被调查者的怀疑和猜忌。

sentences.en: The president has been sowing doubt and suspicion about elections for years when he was out of power.
sentences.zh: 总统在下台时多年来一直在播下对选举的怀疑和猜忌。

sentences.en: And now what you're seeing is that now that he's in power, he can use the levers of government.
sentences.zh: 而现在你看到的是，既然他掌权了，他就可以利用政府的杠杆。

sentences.en: He can use the mechanics of something like the FBI to sow that doubt and sow that suspicion.
sentences.zh: 他可以利用像联邦调查局这样的机构的机制来播下那种怀疑和猜忌。

sentences.en: And that doubt and suspicion becomes the official posture of the government.
sentences.zh: 而那种怀疑和猜忌就成了政府的官方立场。

sentences.en: Well, Devlin, thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 好的，德夫林，非常感谢你。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: In a radio interview on Monday afternoon, President Trump escalated his claims of election fraud, declaring that Republicans should take control of elections across the country.
sentences.zh: 在周一下午的一次广播采访中，特朗普总统升级了他的选举欺诈指控，宣称共和党人应该控制全国的选举。

sentences.en: The Republicans should say, we want to take over.
sentences.zh: 共和党人应该说，我们想要接管。

sentences.en: We should take over the voting, the voting in at least many, 15 places.
sentences.zh: 我们应该接管投票，至少在许多地方，15个地方的投票。

sentences.en: The Republicans ought to nationalize the voting.
sentences.zh: 共和党人应该将投票国有化。

sentences.en: That prompted a swift rebuke from the Democratic leader in the Senate, Chuck Schumer.
sentences.zh: 这引起了参议院民主党领袖查克·舒默的迅速谴责。

sentences.en: You think he believes in democracy?
sentences.zh: 你认为他相信民主吗？

sentences.en: Does Donald Trump need a copy of the Constitution?
sentences.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普需要一份宪法副本吗？

sentences.en: What he's saying is outlandishly illegal.
sentences.zh: 他所说的是荒谬的非法行为。

sentences.en: Once again, the president's talking notes.
sentences.zh: 总统的谈话要点再次出现了。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 这是你今天还需要知道的其他事情。

sentences.en: On Monday, the Secretary of Homeland Security, Kristi Noem, announced that body cameras would immediately be given to federal officers working in Minneapolis.
sentences.zh: 周一，国土安全部长克里斯蒂·诺姆宣布，在明尼阿波利斯工作的联邦官员将立即配备随身摄像头。

sentences.en: It was the Trump administration's latest effort to adjust its tactics amid a national outcry over the killing of two American citizens.
sentences.zh: 这是特朗普政府在两名美国公民被杀引发全国抗议之际，调整其策略的最新努力。

sentences.en: The first, Renee Good, by an ICE agent.
sentences.zh: 第一位是蕾妮·古德，被一名移民及海关执法局特工杀害。

sentences.en: The second, Alex Preddy, by two Border Patrol agents.
sentences.zh: 第二位是亚历克斯·普雷迪，被两名边境巡逻队特工杀害。

sentences.en: Noem said that the body cameras would eventually be given to all Homeland Security agents across the country.
sentences.zh: 诺姆表示，随身摄像头最终将提供给全国所有的国土安全部特工。

sentences.en: And a proposed deal to end a partial government shutdown, reached last week by President Trump and Senate Democrats,
sentences.zh: 而上周由特朗普总统和参议院民主党人达成的结束部分政府停摆的拟议协议，

sentences.en: has stumbled in the House, where some Republicans are threatening to block its passage.
sentences.zh: 在众议院受阻，一些共和党人威胁要阻止其通过。

sentences.en: Several hardline conservatives have demanded policy changes to the funding package, including a requirement that people show identification before voting.
sentences.zh: 几位强硬派保守党人要求对资金方案进行政策修改，包括要求人们在投票前出示身份证件。

sentences.en: Democrats who oppose such requirements say that change would kill the funding package, which could further extend the shutdown by days, if not weeks.
sentences.zh: 反对这种要求的民主党人表示，这一改变将扼杀资金方案，这可能会使停摆进一步延长几天，甚至几周。

sentences.en: For decades, the Brooklyn Democratic Party operated as a tightly controlled machine, until this summer.
sentences.zh: 几十年来，布鲁克林民主党一直作为一个严密控制的机器运作，直到今年夏天。

sentences.en: When elections ushered in a bunch of self-described reformers.
sentences.zh: 当时选举迎来了一群自称改革者的人。

sentences.en: Ever since, the party has been in the grip of a bruising, chaotic, and sometimes thrilling fight.
sentences.zh: 从那以后，该党一直处于一场伤痕累累、混乱不堪，有时又令人兴奋的斗争之中。

sentences.en: In the latest episode of Metro, with me, Sarah Koenig, stories of people trying to maintain their influence and losing control along the way.
sentences.zh: 在《地铁》的最新一集中，我和莎拉·凯尼格将讲述人们试图维持影响力却在过程中失去控制的故事。

sentences.en: Metro.
sentences.zh: 地铁。

sentences.en: Listen wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 在任何你获取播客的地方收听。

sentences.en: Heroic proteSt.
sentences.zh: 英勇的抗议。

sentences.en: Heroic teSt.
sentences.zh: 英勇的考验。
